description: Port the collaborative runtime stores to Python (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §7 port band): collections, annotations, changelog, stewardship, citations. Each is a JSON-per-record store under data/runtime/ with a thin route group. Runs in parallel with the other port tasklists.

userStories.title: Port collections + annotations
userStories.description: Reimplement the collections and annotations services + routes on the FastAPI service, backed by their data/runtime/ JSON stores.
acceptanceCriteria: collections and annotations routes are served by auto-registered Python routers and pass the parity tests.
Stores read/write data/runtime/{collections,annotations} matching current behavior.
Express handlers removed or 501; coverage tracker updated.

userStories.title: Port changelog + stewardship + citations
userStories.description: Reimplement changelog (audit log), stewardship (culture stewards), and citations on the FastAPI service.
acceptanceCriteria: changelog, stewardship, and citations routes pass the parity tests.
Stores read/write data/runtime/{changelog,stewardship} (and the citations store) matching current behavior.
